Ladies and gentlemen, good day, and welcome to Laurus Labs Q2 FY27 Earnings Conference 
Call hosted by DAM Capital Ltd. As a reminder, all participant lines will be in the listen-only 
mode and there will be an opportunity for you to ask questions after the presentation concludes. 
Should you need assistance during the conference call, please signal an operator by pressing star 
then zero on your touch-tone phone. Please note that this conference is being recorded. 
I now hand the conference over to Mr. Nitin Agarwal from DAM Capital Advisors Limited. 
Please go ahead, sir. 
Nitin Agarwal: 
Thank you. Good afternoon, everyone, and a very warm welcome to Laurus Labs Q2 FY27 
Earnings Call hosted by DAM Capital Advisors Limited. On the call today, we have representing 
Laurus Labs management are, Dr. Satyanarayana Chava, Founder and CEO; Mr. V. V. Ravi 
Kumar, Executive Director and CFO; Mr. Krishna Chaitanya Chava, ED, Head CDMO; Mrs. 
Soumya Chava, ED, Affordable Medicines and Commercial; and Mr. Vivek Kumar, AVP, 
Investor Relations. 
 
Before we proceed, I would like to remind you that some of the statements made during the call 
today could be forward-looking in nature, and a safe harbor statement to this effect has been 
included in the press release that has been shared on the company's website. 
I hand over the call to Dr. Chava to make the opening comments, and then we'll open the floor 
for questions. Please go ahead, sir. 
Satyanarayana Chava: 
Thanks, Nitin. Good afternoon to all our stakeholders. We are pleased with the substantial 
progress company making across various business segments. We continue to report strong 
growth in CDMO business, steady momentum in affordable medicine portfolio because of our 
major advancement in our partners' clinical and commercial programs. 
The strong performance reflects sustainable robust demand for our specialized capabilities, 
integrated offerings, depth of our customer relationships and disciplined operational execution 
by our team. In line with our accelerating transformation strategy, we are actively investing into 
building scientific capabilities and capacities across complex and new modalities. 
 
The company's total reactor volume for small molecules API in operation has now reached over 
9,000 kiloliters, and we will continue to expand further. We are also pleased to highlight some 
of the important disclosures we have made in this quarter's investor presentation on the 
advancements we are making in our integrated peptide CDMO capability.  
We commissioned commercial-scale peptide manufacturing block. Our current reactor volume 
for solid-phase peptide synthesis is over 16,000 liters, and we have taken up a significant further 
expansions to meet diverse program requirements. We continue to strengthen the capacity of 
liquid-phase peptide synthesis and several new technologies. 
 
We are also augmenting our capacity through disciplined business development. During the 
quarter, we have announced investment into 2 technology platform companies. The one is an

October 29, 2026

agreement to acquire majority 60% stake in Canada-based Galenvs Sciences, specializing in 
oligonucleotides and precision magnetic nanoparticles-based purification. 
By leveraging Galenvs's expertise in early-stage oligo projects, process development, 
conjugation, advance purification and fill finish, along with Laurus's large-scale expertise in 
complex chemistry, we intend to support clients with seamless journey from complex RNA 
DNA-based therapies as a one-stop solution. Together, this will expand Laurus's position to 
participate in emerging high-growth oligo market. 
 
Second is an acquisition of majority stake in SI & C Resins, a peptide resin technology-focused 
company based out of Hyderabad. This will allow us to enhance long-term supply security by 
in-sourcing critical solid support resins for peptide synthesis and also chromatography stationary 
phases for large-scale peptide purification. This will bolster Laurus's manufacturing 
competitiveness and reliability with our current and future partners' programs.  
These acquisitions are aimed to advance Laurus's integrated scientific capabilities under one 
roof. These acquisitions are strengthened by Laurus's quality infrastructure that will cater to 
more complex customized projects, along with significant increase in future therapeutic 
demands. 
 
Moving on to our financial results. Laurus has maintained its growth trajectory and once again 
delivered a record revenue and profits for quarter 2. Total revenues were INR2,206 crores, 
reflecting a continued strength of our CDMO platform, growing contribution from commercial-
based supplies and ongoing momentum in Affordable medicines portfolio. 
Gross margins were also healthy and maintained at around 63%, and EBITDA margins further 
expanded over previous quarters by 2.7 percentage points to 34.5%. Our product mix and 
operating leverage continue to do well, supporting healthy margins overall.

operational execution in Q2, reporting an 86% growth with the sales of INR875 crores. For the 
first half of the current financial year, the division recorded INR1,710 crores. That equates to 
about 77% growth. 
This performance was driven by successful delivery of critical late-stage programs as well as 
commercial API supplies to multiple global partners. We also continue to see encouraging 
demand on the newly commissioned assets across both Human Health and Animal Health 
businesses, both in terms of the volumes and opportunities with existing partners as well as with 
new client engagements. 
 
The company remains focused on enhancing our core capabilities and capacities to better meet 
customer demand driven by continuous expansions. As Dr. Satya highlighted in the opening

remains on securing fully integrated projects, seamlessly supporting partners from preclinical 
development going all the way to finished drug product services. Driven by this end-to-end 
capability, our CDMO pipeline continues to expand.  
We are adding clinical programs across a highly diversified mix of manufacturing technologies 
as well as therapeutic indications. I would say with our capability expansion, deeper integration 
and expanding pipeline, Laurus is well positioned to sustain a healthy business growth in the 
coming years.

ARV portfolio and developed market portfolios.

launches, integrated CMO engagements and ongoing expansion of product registrations across 
key emerging markets, which is creating new business opportunities for us.
